question: How can I display only the request body schema for an endpoint using the EndpointSchemaSnippet component?
ground_truth: To display only the request body schema using the EndpointSchemaSnippet component, you need to set the selector prop to "request.body". For example: <EndpointSchemaSnippet endpoint="POST /chat/{{domain}}" selector="request.body" />

metadata.cited_context: The `<EndpointSchemaSnippet>` component displays endpoint schemas from your API Reference. By default, it renders the complete schema, or you can use the `selector` prop to display specific parts like request body, response, path parameters, or query parameters. ### Request body <EndpointSchemaSnippet endpoint="POST /chat/{{domain}}" selector="request.body" />
